description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the fixed workflow: it must build a JSON payload matching the proprietary schema in references/report-json-schema.md (required fields: question, sources array with at least one official-doc entry with full citation metadata including title/publisher/url/accessed, and recommended_steps). 2. The agent populates system_context with SAP S/4HANA Cloud details, adds clarifications/assumptions relevant to the AP reconciliation scenario, and includes validation_checks and risks_open_items. 3. PROPRIETARY TRAP: Because the user requested 'question-and-answer style', the agent must map this to the format value 'simple q-and-a' as described in the skill — and then further map that to the CLI flag value 'q-and-a' (NOT 'simple q-and-a', NOT 'qa', NOT any other variant). An agent without SKILL.md will likely pass the raw string 'simple q-and-a' or 'q&a' to --format, causing the script to reject it with an argparse error. 4. The agent invokes: python scripts/build_system_guidance_docx.py --input-json <analysis.json> --output-docx ap_reconciliation_guidance.docx --format q-and-a. 5. The resulting DOCX must contain the q-and-a specific headings ('Answer: Recommended Actions', 'How To Confirm Success') and must NOT contain memo-only headings ('Validation Checks'), confirming the correct format flag was used.
